# Toy Screwdriver Handle (9mm Square Bit)

![Render](render.png)

## Description
This is a parametric, kid-friendly ergonomic toy screwdriver handle designed for a 9mm square bit. It features a bulbous palm swell, a rounded rear pommel, an ergonomic finger waist, a forward safety collar to prevent fingers from slipping, tactile grip flutes around the circumference, a tapered lead-in funnel chamfer to guide the bit in easily, and an optional internal pocket for an 8x3mm retention disc magnet.

## Download

- [⬇️ `toy_screwdriver_handle.stl`](toy_screwdriver_handle.stl) (322 KB): print-ready model

Binary STL rendered from the `.scad` with its default settings. On GitHub, click a file for an interactive 3D preview, then use **Download raw file**. To change dimensions, use the playground link below.

## Try it out
To modify the model or print an STL/3MF file, you can view this live in the OpenSCAD playground by following this link:
[OpenSCAD Playground](https://ochafik.com/openscad2/#)

## Key Parameters
- `bit_width` (9.0mm): Nominal width of the square screwdriver bit.
- `bit_clearance` (0.3mm): Per-side clearance for 3D printing fit.
- `bit_depth` (25.0mm): Insertion depth of the square bit socket.
- `handle_length` (80.0mm): Total handle length sized for kids' hands.
- `max_diameter` (38.0mm): Main bulbous palm swell diameter.
- `num_flutes` (6): Number of rounded tactile grip grooves around the circumference.
- `include_magnet_pocket` (true): Enables an internal pocket for an 8x3mm retention disc magnet.
